mainEntity.name: Can I use AI for newsletter research if I have almost no budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: A low-budget setup can begin with one AI assistant, a repeatable prompt, a source checklist, and a manual review process. Run My AI Biz recommends starting with one relevant workflow and expanding only after it works in practice. You do not need a coordinated group of assistants to produce a useful issue. Spend effort first on a narrow audience promise and reliable source handling rather than extra automation. Keep a simple spreadsheet with source, date, claim, status, and editorial decision. Paid tools or subscriptions become easier to evaluate after measuring saved time, corrections, subscriber responses, and publishing consistency.
